response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, l.CPK * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> ''), g AS (SELECT sex, AVG(ratio) AS a FROM r WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sex), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g), k1 AS (SELECT g.sex, g.a FROM g, m1 WHERE g.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.sex, k1.a FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_of_remaining, AVG(k2.a - m1.m) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(k2.a - m2.m) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2, m1, m2

assumptions.assumption: A test with GPT = 0 has a missing ratio (division by zero treated as NULL) and is ignored, as are tests with NULL CPK or GPT.
The ratio is computed as real (non-integer) division of CPK by GPT.
The group mean is the plain mean of the per-sex averages, not weighted by the number of tests.
